rule: All 6 must be YES for WORLD_CLASS_DOSSIER = YES, unless documented exception

questions.question: Is the mechanism technically credible?
questions.note: NEW: prevents well-documented bad ideas from passing

questions.question: Could an external engineer understand the technology without the inventor?
Could they reproduce or interrogate the relevant evidence?
Could they identify exactly what remains unknown?
Could they commission the next technical action?
Could they make a rational transfer/transaction decision?

verdict_rule: WORLD_CLASS_DOSSIER = YES requires all 6 questions = YES plus no fatal dossier-integrity defect. If WCQ-01 = NO (mechanism not credible), WORLD_CLASS_DOSSIER = NO regardless of documentation quality.
